Players Committee card image of [[Jakku: Rey's Encampment (ALT)]] (original).

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/jakkureysencampment_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/54fa57db405a50a64f32745b419661935939ef63 54fa57d] (31 August 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
